BiblicalUsage: Yâtsa means to strew, to spread something out as a surface. In every province the Jews lay in sackcloth and ashes when the king's decree came, and Isaiah says the worm is spread under the fallen king of Babylon.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that what is spread under the proud is the worm, and God lays the mighty low.
